options.reason: The table pairs a per-sample gene-expression matrix (23k transcript features on a common normalized scale) with a single two-level label (1: n=68, 0: n=47) and a unique sample_id, matching the brief to predict progesterone-receptor status from RNA-seq. Binary classification with label as the sole target is appropriate; sample_id is a row key excluded from features, and no column is a recoding or post-outcome derivative of PR status, so no leakage column exists.
